name: gitlab-mcp-community
description: Community GitLab MCP server with GraphQL discovery and team-activity analytics. Not affiliated with GitLab Inc.'s first-party MCP server.

gitlab_url.title: GitLab URL
gitlab_url.description: Base URL of your GitLab instance (e.g. https://gitlab.com or your self-hosted host).

gitlab_token.title: GitLab Personal Access Token
gitlab_token.description: Personal access token. Use a read_api-scoped PAT for read-only access, or an api-scoped PAT to also allow writes (create_issue, create_merge_request, etc.). Stored in your OS keychain.
